title: Automatically Building Machine-Checked Assurance Cases from C Codebases to Requirements
title_zh: 从 C 代码库到需求自动构建机器可检查的保证案例

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating interactive theorem proving, yet verification of real-world C codebases requires more than discharging individual proof goals. The task involves jointly constructing expressive function specifications and their proofs, and ensuring that library interfaces compose along intended call sequences even without a designated client. This paper presents CCV , an LLM-assisted framework for building machine-checked assurance cases: structured, auditable artifacts supporting the claim that a C codebase meets its intended requirements. To model intended cross-interface use in open libraries, CCV constructs an interface protocol that exposes permitted call sequences and resource assumptions for review, with a conditional safety guarantee under verified contracts and caller obligations. CCV coordinates two complementary phases: (i) requirement-guided analysis and bottom-up construction of candidate specifications and protocols; and (ii) modular proof construction with feedback that revises the specifications and proofs. Implemented using VST in Rocq, CCV verifies memory safety and leak freedom for all 299 function definitions across six C benchmarks, including industrial cryptographic components, with less than one person-day of reported human effort per benchmark. The guarantees depend on disclosed contracts and assumptions; human review supplies the conformance judgments connecting the formal artifacts to the intended requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化交互式定理证明方面展现出巨大潜力，但验证真实世界中的 C 语言代码库所需的不仅仅是完成单个证明目标。 该任务需要联合构建具有表现力的函数规格及其证明，并确保即使在没有指定客户端的情况下，库接口也能按照预期的调用序列进行组合。 本文提出了 CCV——一个由 LLM 辅助的框架，用于构建机器可验证的保证案例：即结构清晰、可供审计的产物，用以支持“C 语言代码库满足其预期要求”这一主张。 为了在开放库中模拟预期的跨接口使用方式，CCV 构建了一个接口协议，该协议会公开允许的调用序列和资源假设以供审查，并在经过验证的合同和调用者义务条件下提供条件性安全保证。 CCV 协调两个互补的阶段：（i）由需求引导的分析以及候选规格和协议的自底向上构建；以及（ii）通过反馈对规格和证明进行修订的模块化证明构建。 CCV 基于 VST 在 Rocq 中实现，能够验证六个 C 语言基准测试中全部 299 个函数定义的记忆安全性和无泄漏特性，包括工业级密码组件，且每个基准测试报告的人类工作量均不足一人日。 这些保证依赖于所披露的合同和假设；而人类审查则提供合规性判断，将形式化产物与预期需求联系起来。

paragraphs.en: C codebases continue to carry the weight of safety-critical systems, and their formal verification rests on a machine-checked foundation: Hoare-style deductive verification represents intended behavior by function contracts (a.k.a., specifications ) and proves that implementations satisfy them ( Hoare, 1969 ) . Such verification has provided assurance of critical systems, but developing the necessary contracts and proofs remains costly human work ( Klein et al., 2014 ; Leroy, 2009 ) .
paragraphs.zh: C语言代码库持续承载着安全关键系统的重任，其形式化验证建立于机器可检查的基础之上：Hoare风格的演绎验证通过函数契约（亦称“规范”）来表示预期行为，并证明实现满足这些契约（Hoare, 1969）。 交互式定理证明器（ITPs）支持一种生成证明的验证方式：ITP会论证一个形式化陈述——即代码符合其声明的契约——从而为该陈述提供机器可检查的证据（Leroy, 2009；Klein et al., 2009）。 此类验证已为关键系统提供了可靠性保障，但制定必要的契约和证明仍然是一项耗费大量人力成本的工作（Klein et al., 2014；Leroy, 2009）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has made substantial progress in using large language models (LLMs) to automate proof construction (and repair) in ITPs ( First et al., 2023 ; Sanchez-Stern et al., 2020 ; Kozyrev et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Kasibatla et al., 2026 ; Thompson et al., 2025 ; Mukherjee et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Yet proof-construction automation alone does not meet the verification needs of a large real-world C codebase. Typically it necessitates establishing an end-to-end assurance case ( ISO/IEC, 2019 ; Mansourov and Campara, 2011 ) : not only formal evidence that the implementation satisfies its specifications, but also an auditable argument that those specifications, taken together, conform to the intended requirements. This raises two challenges at different levels.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究在使用大型语言模型（LLM）自动化 ITP 中的证明构建（及修复）方面取得了重大进展（First 等人，2023；Sanchez-Stern 等人，2020；Kozyrev 等人，2024；Lu 等人，2024；Kasibatla 等人，2026；Thompson 等人，2025；Mukherjee 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2026a）。 然而，仅靠证明构建的自动化仍无法满足大型真实世界 C 语言代码库的验证需求。 通常，这需要建立一个端到端的保障案例（ISO/IEC，2019；Mansourov 和 Campara，2011）：不仅需要形式化证据来证明实现满足其规格要求，还需要一个可审计的论证来说明这些规格要求综合起来符合预期需求。 这带来了两个不同层面上的挑战。

paragraphs.en: First, how to construct function-level verification—the specification of a function and a machine-checked proof that its body satisfies the specification? The two obligations are coupled : the concrete form of a specification–what it promises and how it is phrased–decisively shapes whether a body proof can go through, and proof attempts in turn expose where the specification is too strong, too weak, or mis-expressed. A usable, provable pair is therefore the outcome of an iterative co-evolution, not of a single synthesis pass. Methods that construct proofs ( First et al., 2023 ; Sanchez-Stern et al., 2020 ; Kozyrev et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Kasibatla et al., 2026 ; Thompson et al., 2025 ; Mukherjee et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) of stated theorems take the specification as given, and methods that synthesize contracts ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) —typically validated by auto-active backends rather than an ITP kernel—stop before a machine-checked body proof. We develop this first challenge in Section 2.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，如何构建函数级验证——即一个函数的规范及其机器可验证的证明，证明其函数体满足该规范？ 这两项义务是相互耦合的：规范的具体形式——它承诺了什么以及其表述方式——会决定性地影响函数体证明能否成功，而证明尝试反过来也会揭示规范是否过于严格、过于宽松或表达不当。 因此，一个可用且可验证的规范-证明对，是迭代协同演化的结果，而非单次综合步骤的产物。 构建已陈述定理证明的方法（First 等，2023；Sanchez-Stern 等，2020；Kozyrev 等，2024；Lu 等，2024；Kasibatla 等，2026；Thompson 等，2025；Mukherjee 等，2025；Wang 等，2026a）将规范作为既定前提，而合成契约的方法（Wang 等，2026b；Wen 等，2024；Ma 等，2025）——通常由自动激活的后端而非 ITP 内核进行验证——则在机器可验证的函数体证明之前终止。 我们在第 2.1 节中详细阐述这一首要挑战。

paragraphs.en: Second, how to establish library-level conformance—that the exported interfaces, taken together, conform to the intended requirements? A library is a collection of modules, and the specifications of its externally callable functions (e.g., typically the module-entry functions) form its interfaces . An open library has no designated client functions (e.g., a main ), a category that a substantial part of real-world codebases falls into ( Beringer, 2021 ; Henzinger et al., 2005 ) . Verifying an open library therefore raises a common difficulty: proofs can establish that each module satisfies its interface, but the requirements of a library are often stated over the order in which its interfaces may be called, and per-module proofs do not by themselves show that those interfaces, taken together, support the call sequences the requirements expect. Yet existing LLM-assisted methods stop at function-level verification, leaving whether the library’s interfaces, taken together, conform to the requirements an open problem that typically becomes a manual-review obligation. We develop this second challenge in Section 2.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 其次，如何建立库级别的合规性——即确保所有导出的接口综合起来符合预期要求？ 一个库是多个模块的集合，其外部可调用函数的规范（例如，通常是模块入口函数）构成了它的接口。 开放库没有指定的客户端函数（例如 main 函数），而这一类别涵盖了现实中大量代码库的情况（Beringer, 2021; Henzinger et al., 2005）。 因此，验证开放库会面临一个常见难题：证明可以确认每个模块都满足其接口规范，但库的要求通常涉及其接口被调用的顺序，而针对单个模块的证明本身并不能说明这些接口综合起来是否支持要求所期望的调用序列。 然而，现有的 LLM 辅助方法仅止步于函数级别的验证，使得“库的接口综合起来是否符合要求”这一问题仍然悬而未决，通常只能依赖人工审查来解决。 我们将在第 2.2 节中详细阐述这一第二个挑战。

paragraphs.en: In response to these challenges, we present CCV , an LLM-assisted framework for building machine-checked assurance cases from C codebases to their requirements. To model intended cross-interface use in open libraries, CCV constructs an interface protocol that describes permitted calls, their possible outcomes, and the resources carried between them. The protocol guides the synthesis of composable interfaces and exposes their call sequences and assumptions for review. Its soundness theorem provides a conditional safety guarantee under verified function contracts and the stated caller obligations.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 CCV——一个借助大语言模型（LLM）构建机器可验证保障案例的框架，该框架适用于从 C 代码库到其需求的场景。 为了对开放库中预期的跨接口使用进行建模，CCV 构建了一个接口协议，用于描述允许的调用、其可能的结果以及它们之间传递的资源。 该协议指导了可组合接口的合成，并揭示了其调用序列和假设以供审查。 其正确性定理在已验证的函数契约和声明的调用者义务条件下，提供了有条件的安全性保证。

paragraphs.en: CCV coordinates specification synthesis and proof construction in two complementary phases. The first phase uses top-down analysis to derive natural-language function contracts from requirements and caller demands, then formalizes these contracts bottom-up and constructs a candidate interface protocol. The second phase constructs modular proofs that function bodies satisfy their contracts and that the contracts support the protocol. Proof feedback drives revisions to the specifications, protocol, and proofs, rather than treating the initial specifications as fixed. This specification–proof co-evolution connects function-level verification to the library-level requirements expressed through the protocol.
paragraphs.zh: CCV 在两个互补的阶段中协调规范合成与证明构建。 第一阶段采用自上而下的分析方法，从需求和调用方要求中推导出自然语言形式的函数契约，然后自下而上将这些契约形式化，并构建一个候选接口协议。 第二阶段构建模块化证明，以验证函数体满足其契约，且这些契约支持该协议。 证明反馈会推动规范、协议和证明的修订，而不是将初始规范视为固定不变。 这种规范与证明的协同演化，将函数级别的验证与通过协议表达的库级别需求连接起来。

sents.en: CCV coordinates specification synthesis and proof construction in two complementary phases.
sents.zh: CCV 在两个互补的阶段中协调规范合成与证明构建。

sents.en: The first phase uses top-down analysis to derive natural-language function contracts from requirements and caller demands, then formalizes these contracts bottom-up and constructs a candidate interface protocol.
sents.zh: 第一阶段采用自上而下的分析方法，从需求和调用方要求中推导出自然语言形式的函数契约，然后自下而上将这些契约形式化，并构建一个候选接口协议。

sents.en: The second phase constructs modular proofs that function bodies satisfy their contracts and that the contracts support the protocol.
sents.zh: 第二阶段构建模块化证明，以验证函数体满足其契约，且这些契约支持该协议。

sents.en: Proof feedback drives revisions to the specifications, protocol, and proofs, rather than treating the initial specifications as fixed.
sents.zh: 证明反馈会推动规范、协议和证明的修订，而不是将初始规范视为固定不变。

sents.en: This specification–proof co-evolution connects function-level verification to the library-level requirements expressed through the protocol.
sents.zh: 这种规范与证明的协同演化，将函数级别的验证与通过协议表达的库级别需求连接起来。

paragraphs.en: We implement CCV using VST in Rocq and apply it to six C libraries, including four cryptographic components of openHiTLS. The delivered proofs establish memory safety and leak freedom for all 299 function definitions under disclosed contracts and assumptions, with less than one person-day of reported human effort per benchmark. Machine checking validates the formal evidence; human review supplies the conformance judgments linking the specifications and protocol to the intended requirements.

paragraphs.en: Function-level verification is the process of producing, jointly, a specification that states what the given function is meant to do and a machine-checked proof that the body inhabits that specification. For example, the function ( Fig. 1(a) ) walks a linked list and returns its length. Figure 1(b) shows the shape of a specification in VST/Rocq: it binds a list of logic variables ( WITH ) and then states a precondition ( PRE ) and a postcondition ( POST ). Each of PRE and POST carries two groups of assertions: a PROP clause, a conjunction of pure logical propositions that do not depend on the heap, and a SEP clause, a separating conjunction of spatial predicates describing the heap fragments the function requires (in PRE ) or returns (in POST ). The PARAMS and GLOBALS clauses name the formal parameters and globals, and RETURN names the return value. The proof ( Fig. 1(c) ) is a Hoare-style judgment of the lemma verify_list_length , asserting that the body inhabits its specification. In VST the proof is built interactively by forward symbolic execution : a tactic (e.g., forward , forward_loop , forward_if ) advances the symbolic proof state—the local environment together with the heap—past one statement at a time, in the manner of a strongest-postcondition transformer; once the whole body has been consumed, the remaining goals are closed by pure reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 函数级验证是一个联合生成规范的过程：该规范说明给定函数的预期功能，并提供一个机器可验证的证明，证明函数体符合该规范。 例如，函数（图 1(a)）遍历一个链表并返回其长度。 图 1(b) 展示了 VST/Rocq 中规范的结构：它首先绑定一组逻辑变量（WITH），然后声明一个前提条件（PRE）和一个后置条件（POST）。 PRE 和 POST 各自包含两组断言：PROP 子句，即一组不依赖堆的纯逻辑命题的合取；以及 SEP 子句，即描述函数所需（在 PRE 中）或返回（在 POST 中）的堆分片的空间谓词的分离合取。 PARAMS 和 GLOBALS 子句分别指定形式参数和全局变量，而 RETURN 则指定返回值。 该证明（图 1(c)）是一个 Hoare 风格的引理 verify_list_length 的判断，断言函数体符合其规范。 在 VST 中，证明通过正向符号执行交互式构建：一个策略（例如 forward、forward_loop、forward_if）以最强后置条件变换器的方式，逐步推进符号证明状态——即局部环境与堆——每次处理一条语句；整个函数体处理完毕后，剩余目标通过纯推理完成闭合。

paragraphs.en: The bottleneck of function-level verification lies in the inherent coupling of constructing the specification and the proof . The nature of this coupling is best seen through a concrete failure. Take the initial contract of Fig. 1(b) , which imposes no pure-logic constraints on the input list (i.e., PROP () in the precondition). It looks unobjectionable: the implementation obviously counts the elements, and the postcondition states exactly this. The proof, however, does not go through. forward_loop on the while loop yields the three standard obligations—establishment, preservation, and termination of the inductive loop invariant—which are discharged routinely. The trouble appears at the assignment c = c + 1 : here forward generates a signed-overflow proof goal, requiring that the incremented value still fit in an int , since an overflowing addition is undefined behavior (UB) in C. To proceed, one must revise the specification, strengthening its precondition with the bound ( Zlength xs <= Int.max_signed ); under this refinement the overflow goal closes and an ordinary loop proof succeeds. The specification is thus shaped by the proof, and the proof can advance only as far as the specification permits—the two co-evolve, each constraining and refining the other.
paragraphs.zh: 函数级验证的瓶颈在于构建规范与证明之间的内在耦合。 这种耦合的性质通过一个具体的失败案例最能体现出来。 以图 1(b) 中的初始合同为例，它对输入列表没有施加任何纯逻辑约束（即前置条件中的 PROP ()）。 这看起来无可挑剔：实现显然会统计元素数量，而后置条件也明确指出了这一点。 然而，证明却无法成立。对 while 循环执行 forward_loop 会产生三个标准的义务——归纳循环不变量的建立、保持和终止——这些通常都能顺利满足。 问题出现在赋值语句 c = c + 1 处：此时 forward 会生成一个带符号溢出证明目标，要求递增后的值仍然能容纳在 int 类型中，因为溢出的加法操作在 C 语言中是未定义行为（UB）。 要继续下去，必须修改规范，通过添加边界条件 (Zlength xs <= Int.max_signed) 来加强其前置条件；在这种改进下，溢出目标得以解决，普通的循环证明也能成功。 因此，规范是由证明塑造的，而证明也只能在规范允许的范围内推进——两者协同演化，彼此制约并相互完善。

paragraphs.en: The difficulty is far more severe in real-world verification, where contracts are far richer than a single bound and the point at which a proof stalls is seldom as local as one assignment: determining whether an obstruction calls for a stronger hypothesis, a sharper invariant, a different specification shape, or a genuinely weaker requirement is a judgment made against the proof in flight. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 gives an overview of this assurance case. It has five components connected by four kinds of relations; the three components and two relations in the shaded region are formal artifacts that CCV produces automatically and VST/Rocq checks. The C codebase is the input under verification, while the requirements reflect the design intent. Starting from the codebase, CompCert’s front end mechanically translates the C source into a Clight AST ( Leroy, 2009 ) (\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{1}}⃝). CCV generates specifications for the Clight functions and proofs that the functions satisfy those specifications (\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{2}}⃝). For an open library, CCV also constructs an interface protocol to describe the interface-call sequences permitted by the requirements, and proves that every interface-call sequence accepted by the protocol is safe with respect to the verified function specifications (\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{3}}⃝). The remaining manual obligation in the assurance case is to review whether the function specifications and the interface protocol conform to the requriements (\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{4}}⃝), for instance whether a precondition is too strong or the protocol omits a legal and safe interface-call sequence. We formalize the interface protocol in Section 4 , and explain how CCV constructs this assurace case in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 概述了此保障案例。 它包含五个通过四种关系连接的分组件；阴影区域中的三个分组件和两种关系是 CCV 自动生成的形式化产物，并由 VST/Rocq 进行验证。 C 代码库是待验证的输入，而需求则反映了设计意图。 从代码库开始，CompCert 的前端将 C 源代码机械地转换为 Clight AST（Leroy, 2009）(\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{1}}⃝)。 CCV 为 Clight 函数生成规范，并证明这些函数满足该规范（\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{2}}⃝）。 对于开放库，CCV 还会构建一个接口协议，以描述需求所允许接口调用序列，并证明协议接受的每个接口调用序列相对于已验证的函数规范都是安全的（\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{3}}⃝）。 该保障案例中剩余的手动工作包括审查函数规范和接口协议是否符合需求（\raisebox{-.87pt}{\texttt{4}}⃝），例如检查前置条件是否过于严格，或协议是否遗漏了合法且安全的接口调用序列。 我们在第 4 节中将接口协议形式化，并在第 5 节中解释 CCV 如何构建此保障案例。

paragraphs.en: As Section 2.2 showed, function-level verification alone does not establish that a library’s interfaces conform to its requirements. The root difficulty is that requirements are abstract—their intended content is a set of legal interface-call sequences—whereas an open library has no client whose control flow could delimit that set. Verifying library-level conformance therefore requires the expert to (i) determine which interface-call sequences the requirements permit and (ii) ensure that the interfaces along those sequences compose, reconciling them where they do not. To support both tasks, CCV constructs an interface protocol : a state-based model that makes the intended interface-call sequences and their assumptions explicit for review and guides the synthesis and refinement of the constituent interfaces.

paragraphs.en: The theorem deliberately separates machine evidence from applicability to a client. H1 and H2 are formal proof obligations; whether an unverified client actually passes the recorded w w , supplies the required borrowed resources, and respects the carried ownership is an exported caller obligation. CCV does not claim to verify that arbitrary client. Nor does the theorem state that every abstract valid run has a corresponding C client: it states that every client execution that realizes such a run is within the verified interface domain.

paragraphs.en: Protocol soundness is necessary but not sufficient for a useful assurance artifact. An unsatisfiable precondition can make a subsumption obligation vacuously easy, an overly strong guard can silently reject intended clients, and an extra branch can describe an outcome that the implementation never produces. CCV therefore subjects the protocol to three additional forms of scrutiny.
paragraphs.zh: 协议健全性对于构建一个实用的保障工具而言是必要的，但并非充分的。 一个不可满足的先决条件可能使子集包含义务变得毫无意义地简单；一个过于严格的守卫可能静默地拒绝预期的客户端；而一个多余的分支则可能描述出实现从未产生的结果。 因此，CCV 将协议置于三种额外的审查形式之下。

paragraphs.en: CCV is organized as an evidence-producing workflow rather than as a one-shot proof search. Agent-working states construct a frozen Clight program, analyze its contractual demands, formalize shared abstractions, and discharge proof obligations. Two explicit human gates review the parts of the assurance case that are not settled by kernel checking: whether the chosen scope and assumptions conform to the intended guarantees, and whether the resulting formal artifacts conform to the intended design. The human decision is on the critical path. A successful run therefore yields both machine-checkable proof evidence and an auditable record of the human judgments on which its interpretation depends. Figure 5 shows the paper-level workflow: yellow states are agent-working states, blue states are human-involved review gates, and the two exit states report the outcome; solid arrows advance the assurance artifacts, and dashed arrows request rework. The workflow is organized around evidence artifacts, not around a single undifferentiated proof task: each agent-working state produces a layer of Figure 4 or the machine-checked relation connecting two layers, and each gate consumes them. All four agent-working states apply both to open libraries and to libraries with a designated main ; the cases differ only in what V_Specify produces—an interface-protocol configuration for the former and a main-level specification for the latter.

paragraphs.en: The workflow implements two complementary phases. paragraphs.en: Three properties of the control flow are worth making explicit. First, the direct edge from V_Analyze to V_Specify makes the early human review an optional early review gate : when the scope and risks are already clear, the agent proceeds to formalization directly. Second, V_Review may send the run back to V_Preprocess : early review can question the frozen Clight program itself, not merely request proof-script patches, and after such a rework the input binding, the analysis, and the specifications are all re-established. Third, V_Confirm observes the proof and protocol artifacts that were actually produced; if they do not faithfully express the reviewer’s decisions, rework enters as a trackable revision request to V_Prove , not as a disclaimer appended to a report. V_Review is a risk-sensitive early gate, whereas a successful run always passes through V_Confirm , which carries the conformance judgment of the specifications and the protocol to the design intent. The exits are scope-honest: V_Failed reports why the claimed assurance could not be responsibly delivered, and V_Succeed delivers the assurance package---proof evidence, scope and assumption disclosure, and the review record---without extending it to universal program correctness. 2 2 2 The implementation contains additional operational states for interruption handling, failure triage, and artifact delivery. We abstract them away here because they do not add a new assurance relation; their responsibilities are reflected in the review records and terminal outcomes.

paragraphs.en: V_Preprocess turns the configured C source and its build context into a reproducible, checkable frozen Clight program, together with the input provenance and a transformation and scope record. Three kinds of input processing must be distinguished, because they differ in what may be claimed. For trusted preprocessing and translation, CCV establishes the frozen Clight program by the regeneration check of Section 3 . For a semantics-preserving source transformation, the preservation claim and the source of its evidence are disclosed separately. For an adaptation that changes the program under verification or replaces environment behavior with new assumptions, no preservation of the original C program’s semantics is claimed: the adaptation changes the assurance scope, is recorded, and becomes an object of V_Review and V_Confirm . This distinction protects the core claim of Section 3 : the reader must know exactly which frozen Clight program was proved, not merely that some “source code” was involved.
paragraphs.zh: V_Preprocess 将配置好的 C 源代码及其构建上下文转换为一个可重复生成、可验证的冻结 Clight 程序，同时附带输入来源以及转换和范围记录。 必须区分三种类型的输入处理，因为它们在可声明的内容上存在差异。 对于可信的前处理和翻译，CCV 通过第 3 节的再生成检查来建立冻结的 Clight 程序。 对于保持语义的源代码转换，其语义保持声明和证据来源将分开披露。 对于在验证过程中修改程序或用新假设替换环境行为的适配，不声称保留原始 C 程序的语义：这种适配会改变保障范围，会被记录，并成为 V_Review 和 V_Confirm 的对象。 这种区分保护了第 3 节的核心声明：读者必须确切知道哪个冻结的 Clight 程序经过了证明，而不仅仅是知道有某种“源代码”参与其中。

sents.en: For a semantics-preserving source transformation, the preservation claim and the source of its evidence are disclosed separately.
sents.zh: 对于保持语义的源代码转换，其语义保持声明和证据来源将分开披露。

sents.en: For an adaptation that changes the program under verification or replaces environment behavior with new assumptions, no preservation of the original C program’s semantics is claimed: the adaptation changes the assurance scope, is recorded, and becomes an object of V_Review and V_Confirm .
sents.zh: 对于在验证过程中修改程序或用新假设替换环境行为的适配，不声称保留原始 C 程序的语义：这种适配会改变保障范围，会被记录，并成为 V_Review 和 V_Confirm 的对象。

sents.en: This distinction protects the core claim of Section 3 : the reader must know exactly which frozen Clight program was proved, not merely that some “source code” was involved.
sents.zh: 这种区分保护了第 3 节的核心声明：读者必须确切知道哪个冻结的 Clight 程序经过了证明，而不仅仅是知道有某种“源代码”参与其中。

paragraphs.en: V_Analyze extracts, from callers, implementations, and design material, the interface functions that define the library boundary, the contractual demands on each function, functional and resource invariants, candidate axiomatic specifications of external functions, and—for an open library—candidate interface-usage constraints. The output is an analysis record with candidate assumptions and the requirements placed on contracts and on the protocol; natural-language analysis by itself is not a soundness theorem, and the state claims nothing beyond a documented basis for formalization. The key discipline is that CCV does not treat specification synthesis as an oracle: it records the assumptions and the analysis-to-specification choices that later reviews must assess.
paragraphs.zh: V_Analyze 会从调用者、实现和设计材料中提取定义库边界的接口函数、对每个函数的契约性要求、功能与资源不变量、外部函数的候选公理规范，以及对于开放库而言的候选接口使用约束。 输出是一个分析记录，其中包含候选假设以及对契约和协议提出的要求；仅凭自然语言分析本身并不能构成健全性定理，该状态也不会声称超出已文档化的形式化基础之外的任何内容。 关键原则在于，CCV 并不将规范合成视为一个预言机：它会记录那些后续审查必须评估的假设以及从分析到规范的转换选择。

paragraphs.en: V_Specify commits the analysis to formal objects: resource predicates, lemma statements, and the library’s funspecs, and, for an open library, the interface protocol’s states, state interpretation, function-labeled transition relation, and source-specific edge specifications. Formalization proceeds from callees to callers, so that caller contracts can refer to existing callee specifications; the resulting definitions and obligations are candidates whose proofs remain to be constructed. For an open library, this configuration also exposes the transition-rule premises and edge preconditions that determine which runs are accepted; their non-vacuity and conformance remain explicit review obligations. Because the analysis is natural-language and the output is formal, the state produces an explicit NL-to-formal change record, so that later review can compare what was approved during analysis with what was actually formalized. The conformance of the resulting specifications to the design intent is not guaranteed by any type system or by the fact that they compile; it is a human judgment deferred to the review gates. The formal semantics of the protocol configuration is given in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: V_Specify 将分析内容固化为形式化对象：资源谓词、引理陈述以及库中的 funspecs；对于开放库，还包括接口协议的状态、状态解释、带函数标签的转换关系以及源特定的边规格。 形式化过程从被调用者向调用者推进，以便调用者契约能够引用现有的被调用者规格；由此产生的定义和义务是待构建证明的候选项。 对于开放库，此配置还暴露了转换规则的 premises 和边的先决条件，这些决定了哪些运行会被接受；它们的非空性和合规性仍属于需要明确审查的义务。 由于分析基于自然语言而输出是形式化的，该状态会生成一份明确的自然语言到形式化的变更记录，以便后续审查能够对比分析阶段批准的内容与实际形式化的内容。 最终规格是否符合设计意图，既不由任何类型系统保证，也不由它们能否编译通过来保证；这属于需要推迟到审查环节进行的人类判断。 协议配置的形式化语义在第 4 节中给出。

paragraphs.en: V_Prove constructs and checks the body-satisfaction proofs and the shared lemmas, and, for an open library, discharges the per-edge subsumption checks and instantiates the generic run-lifting proof underlying protocol soundness. When proof attempts expose a semantic gap, the agent revisits the affected specifications, representations, or protocol and rechecks their dependent proofs; otherwise it continues proof construction under the existing contracts. This feedback supports specification–proof co-evolution within the workflow. Proof construction is accompanied by an audit of dependencies and coverage, so that the absence of admitted holes and the axioms actually used are part of the checked evidence rather than a matter of trust in the agent’s report. Proof success does not imply unconditional correctness beyond the disclosed axiomatic specifications and assumptions. The two kinds of checking are complementary: the Rocq kernel answers whether the stated formal obligations are proved, and human confirmation answers whether those statements say the right thing about the intended design.
paragraphs.zh: V_Prove 构建并验证身体满足性证明和共享引理；对于开放库，它还执行每条边的子集包含检查，并对支撑协议正确性的通用运行提升证明进行实例化。 当证明尝试暴露出语义差距时，智能体会重新审视受影响的规范、表示或协议，并重新检查其依赖的证明；否则，它会在现有契约下继续构建证明。 这种反馈支持工作流中规范与证明的协同演化。 在构建证明的同时，还会对依赖关系和覆盖范围进行审计，从而确保没有未被承认的漏洞，且实际使用的公理成为已验证证据的一部分，而非仅仅依赖于对智能体报告的信任。 证明成功并不意味着在已披露的公理规范和假设之外具有无条件的正确性。 这两种检查是互补的：Rocq 内核负责判断所陈述的形式义务是否已被证明，而人工确认则负责判断这些陈述是否准确描述了预期的设计。

paragraphs.en: The trusted computing base (TCB) of the formal artifacts comprises the Rocq kernel; the VST program logic and its machine-checked soundness connection to the CompCert Clight semantics; the configured but unverified preprocessing and front-end path from C to Clight, pinned to the frozen input by the regeneration check; and the correctness-critical gate code that binds the frozen source and toolchain configuration to the delivered Clight and proof artifacts. These gates also audit proof coverage, the absence of proof holes, and all axioms and premises used by the delivered claims. The case separately discloses the audited logical and model axioms, together with the allocator and external-function premises on which its proofs depend. The LLM agent is not in the TCB: Rocq rechecks every formal statement and proof that it proposes, while the correctness-critical gates validate the source/artifact bindings and audits. Human conformance review is a further explicit assurance boundary, not a kernel-checked theorem. The resulting formal guarantee is relative to the CompCert Clight semantics and these disclosed premises; extending it to an executable requires a downstream verified-compilation step.
paragraphs.zh: 形式化工件的可信计算基础（TCB）包括 Rocq 内核；VST 程序逻辑及其通过机器验证与 CompCert Clight 语义建立的正确性关联；经过配置但未经验证的从 C 到 Clight 的前处理和前端路径，该路径通过再生检查被锁定在冻结输入上；以及将冻结源代码和工具链配置与交付的 Clight 及证明工件绑定的、对正确性至关重要的门控代码。 这些门控还审计了证明覆盖范围、不存在证明漏洞，以及交付主张所使用的全部公理和前提。 该案例单独披露了经过审计的逻辑和模型公理，以及其证明所依赖的分配器和外部函数前提。 LLM 智能体不在 TCB 中：Rocq 会重新检查它提出的每一个形式化陈述和证明，而正确性至关重要的门控则验证源代码与工件的绑定关系及审计过程。 人类合规审查是另一个明确的保障边界，而非由内核验证的定理。 由此产生的形式化保证是相对于 CompCert Clight 语义和这些已披露的前提而言的；要将其扩展到可执行程序，还需要一个下游的已验证编译步骤。

paragraphs.en: We report verification results for six C programs, covering pointer-based data structures and cryptographic components of openHiTLS. The cases comprise 299 function definitions across 18 translation units (TUs). The verification backend uses Rocq 9.0.0, VST 2.16, and CompCert 3.17. The results are supported by archived source, specifications, proofs, certificates, and verification reports.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了六个 C 程序的验证结果，涵盖了 openHiTLS 中的指针基础数据结构和加密组件。 这些案例包含 18 个翻译单元（TU）中的 299 个函数定义。 验证后端使用 Rocq 9.0.0、VST 2.16 和 CompCert 3.17。 这些结果得到了存档的源代码、规范、证明、证书和验证报告的支持。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the verified scope and available run costs. The red–black tree exercises allocation, parent pointers, rotations, and insertion repair, with a designated main . The linked-list entry uses roster , a renamed, single-TU variant of the linked-list library that exercises traversal, deletion, and ownership transfer. The four openHiTLS cases implement ML-DSA and SLH-DSA signatures, SHA-256/224 hashing, and FrodoKEM key encapsulation, together with their context-management operations. C LOC counts physical lines of the original implementation files, excluding headers, preprocessor expansion, and generated Clight syntax. The cryptographic cases cover the listed modules and their configured C implementations; functions outside this scope are represented by disclosed external specifications.

paragraphs.en: CCV requires delivered proofs to be free of admitted obligations; all six cases pass this gate. All 299 function bodies have machine-checked proofs that they satisfy their specifications. The memory-safety guarantees hold under the function preconditions and the stated external specifications, with respect to CompCert Clight semantics. Leak freedom is supported by accounting for heap resources through deallocation or explicit transfer to the caller. For the linked-list, SLH-DSA, SHA-256/224, and FrodoKEM libraries, the delivered evidence additionally includes an interface protocol, per-edge subsumption proofs, and a covering witness. These cases demonstrate function verification and protocol construction across multiple modules; the largest case contains 105 function definitions. The cryptographic algorithms’ functional correctness, termination, and concurrency are outside the scope of these results.
paragraphs.zh: CCV 要求交付的证明不得包含已承认的义务；所有六个案例都通过了这一检验。 全部 299 个函数体都具有机器验证过的证明，表明它们满足各自的规范。 在函数前提条件和所声明的外部规范下，内存安全保证在 CompCert Clight 语义框架内成立。 通过释放堆资源或将其明确转移给调用者，系统支持无泄漏特性。 对于链表、SLH-DSA、SHA-256/224 和 FrodoKEM 库，交付的证据还包括接口协议、每条边的子集证明以及一个覆盖见证。 这些案例展示了跨多个模块的函数验证和协议构建；其中最大的案例包含 105 个函数定义。 这些加密算法的功能正确性、终止性和并发性不在这些研究结果的讨论范围内。

sents.en: All 299 function bodies have machine-checked proofs that they satisfy their specifications.
sents.zh: 全部 299 个函数体都具有机器验证过的证明，表明它们满足各自的规范。

sents.en: The memory-safety guarantees hold under the function preconditions and the stated external specifications, with respect to CompCert Clight semantics.
sents.zh: 在函数前提条件和所声明的外部规范下，内存安全保证在 CompCert Clight 语义框架内成立。

sents.en: Leak freedom is supported by accounting for heap resources through deallocation or explicit transfer to the caller.
sents.zh: 通过释放堆资源或将其明确转移给调用者，系统支持无泄漏特性。

sents.en: For the linked-list, SLH-DSA, SHA-256/224, and FrodoKEM libraries, the delivered evidence additionally includes an interface protocol, per-edge subsumption proofs, and a covering witness.
sents.zh: 对于链表、SLH-DSA、SHA-256/224 和 FrodoKEM 库，交付的证据还包括接口协议、每条边的子集证明以及一个覆盖见证。

sents.en: These cases demonstrate function verification and protocol construction across multiple modules; the largest case contains 105 function definitions.
sents.zh: 这些案例展示了跨多个模块的函数验证和协议构建；其中最大的案例包含 105 个函数定义。

sents.en: The cryptographic algorithms’ functional correctness, termination, and concurrency are outside the scope of these results.
sents.zh: 这些加密算法的功能正确性、终止性和并发性不在这些研究结果的讨论范围内。

paragraphs.en: Elapsed time covers the recorded run through delivery, including interruptions and service delays. For example, FrodoKEM took 17.03 days in total, of which 193.1 hours were confirmed model-service downtime; subtracting those intervals gives 8.99 days. The token column reports total recorded usage by the main agent and its subagents, including input, output, and cache reads, with reasoning included according to the host’s accounting convention. The SHA-256/224 run used GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash through OpenCode, whereas FrodoKEM used Claude Opus 5 through Claude Code. These measurements describe the recorded executions; different models, service availability, and accounting conventions preclude a controlled efficiency comparison. SLH-DSA’s token count and the red–black tree token count remain unavailable in the archived records. The reported human effort is less than one person-day for each benchmark.

paragraphs.en: Review of the SHA-256/224 case identified a self-copy input excluded by the generated contract: CopyCtx(ctx, ctx) reaches a memcpy whose source and destination overlap. The proof remains valid because its precondition requires disjoint source and destination resources, but reviewing that exclusion exposed a library defect for investigation and disclosure. This illustrates the role of requirements-facing review in the assurance case: a provable contract can still exclude a use that merits scrutiny. The present cases provide evidence of completed verification on these selected programs, rather than an estimate of success rate over arbitrary C codebases.
paragraphs.zh: 对 SHA-256/224 案例的审查发现，生成的合同排除了一种自我复制输入：CopyCtx(ctx, ctx) 会触发一个源和目的地重叠的 memcpy。 该证明仍然有效，因为其前提条件要求源和目的地资源不相交，但对该排除条件的审查揭示了一个需要调查和披露的库缺陷。 这说明了面向需求的审查在保障案例中的作用：一个可证明的合同仍然可能排除某种值得深入审查的使用方式。 当前这些案例为这些选定程序已完成验证提供了证据，而非对任意 C 代码库中成功率的估计。

paragraphs.en: We relate CCV to two bodies of work. Section 7.1 positions the central protocol artifact among resource-aware interface models and behavioral-interface synthesis; Section 7.2 compares how verification artifacts are constructed, and what must be trusted, in each approach.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 CCV 与两个研究体系联系起来。 第 7.1 节将核心协议构件置于资源感知接口模型与行为接口合成之中；第 7.2 节则比较了不同方法中验证构件的构建方式以及需要信任的内容。

sents.zh: 第 7.1 节将核心协议构件置于资源感知接口模型与行为接口合成之中；第 7.2 节则比较了不同方法中验证构件的构建方式以及需要信任的内容。

paragraphs.en: Separation-logic and ownership-aware verification already provide the main semantic ingredients of resource-sensitive API reasoning. VST function specifications describe Hoare-style pre- and postconditions over C memory ( Appel, 2011 ) , and systems such as RefinedC interpret refined ownership types in a foundational separation logic ( Sammler et al., 2021 ) . These systems can express interfaces that consume a resource indexed by one abstract configuration and return a resource indexed by another. CCV does not claim this resource-transformer view as a novelty; it builds on it. Its specific role is to organize verified exported API contracts into one reviewable central protocol for a library collection, and to connect that protocol to provider-body proofs and accepted-run closure within a single assurance workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 分离逻辑和所有权感知验证已经提供了资源敏感型 API 推理所需的主要语义要素。 VST 函数规范描述了基于 C 内存的 Hoare 风格前置条件和后置条件（Appel, 2011），而像 RefinedC 这样的系统则在基础分离逻辑中解释了精化的所有权类型（Sammler et al., 2021）。 这些系统能够表达这样的接口：它们消耗一个由抽象配置索引的资源，并返回一个由另一配置索引的资源。 CCV 并未声称这种资源转换器的视角是全新的；它是在此基础之上构建的。 其具体作用是将经过验证的导出 API 契约组织成一个可供审查的中心协议，用于整个库集合，并将该协议与提供者主体证明以及已接受运行闭包连接在同一个保障工作流程中。

paragraphs.en: At the behavioral level, typestate systems and behavioral-interface methods have long represented legal method or API-call sequences ( Strom and Yemini, 1986 ; DeLine and Fähndrich, 2001 ) . More directly, behavioral interface synthesis derives automata of legal library calls from program models that are safe and, under stated assumptions, permissive or full ( Henzinger et al., 2005 ; Alur et al., 2005 ; Beyer et al., 2007 ) . Specification mining and temporal-property inference offer additional ways to propose API protocols from traces, queries, or temporal templates ( Ammons et al., 2002 ; Lemieux et al., 2015 ) . CCV therefore claims neither the first API automaton, nor the first source-derived legal-call language, nor the first use of refinement feedback to construct a protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 在行为层面，类型状态系统和行为接口方法长期以来一直用于表示合法的方法或 API 调用序列（Strom 和 Yemini，1986；DeLine 和 Fähndrich，2001）。 更直接地说，行为接口合成从程序模型中推导出合法库调用的自动机，这些模型是安全的，并且在既定假设下是允许性的或完整的（Henzinger 等，2005；Alur 等，2005；Beyer 等，2007）。 规范挖掘和时态属性推断提供了从轨迹、查询或时态模板中提出 API 协议的额外方法（Ammons 等，2002；Lemieux 等，2015）。 因此，CCV 既未声称拥有首个 API 自动机，也未声称拥有首个源自源代码的合法调用语言，更没有声称首次使用精化反馈来构建协议。

paragraphs.en: Instead, CCV targets a different assurance boundary. Its central protocol is deliberately design-shaped rather than an inferred maximal implementation-safe language; its states are interpreted by VST separation-logic resources; enabled edges are justified by refinement to exported contracts; and the protocol is exposed for human design-conformance review. The contribution here is the integration of a reviewed resource protocol layer into the assurance chain for verified C libraries, not a new general theory of typestate or behavioral-interface synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 相反，CCV 针对的是另一个不同的保障边界。 其核心协议是有意通过设计塑造的，而非某种推断出的、在实现上绝对安全的最大语言；其状态由 VST 分离逻辑资源进行解释；启用的边则通过向导出合同的精化得到验证；并且该协议被公开，以供人类进行设计合规性审查。 本文的贡献在于，将经过审查的资源协议层整合到已验证 C 库的保障链中，而非提出一种关于类型状态或行为接口合成的全新通用理论。

paragraphs.en: We compare along four axes: what is given as input, what is produced, where a specification’s content comes from, and what must ultimately be trusted.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从四个维度进行比较：输入内容、输出结果、规范内容的来源，以及最终必须信任的内容。

paragraphs.en: Most automation for deductive verification takes the specification as given and discharges proof obligations one goal, lemma, or function at a time; the standard benchmarks are built in exactly this way. In interactive provers, hammers translate a stated goal to external automated provers ( Böhme and Nipkow, 2010 ; Czajka and Kaliszyk, 2018 ) , and learning- or LLM-based systems generate, repair, or decompose proofs of stated theorems ( Jiang et al., 2022 ; First et al., 2023 ; Sanchez-Stern et al., 2020 ; Kozyrev et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Kasibatla et al., 2026 ) . Auto-active verifiers such as Dafny, Frama-C/WP, and Verus discharge verification conditions with SMT solvers ( Leino, 2010 ; Kirchner et al., 2015 ; Lattuada et al., 2024 ) ; LLM assistance in this setting supplies helper assertions for failing verifications ( Mugnier et al., 2025 ) , proof hints ( Loughridge et al., 2025 ) , or whole correctness proofs completing code against its given specification ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . RefinedC occupies a middle ground, automating the foundational proof derivation once the user has annotated the C code with refinement types ( Sammler et al., 2021 ) . Reported evaluations across these lines remain at benchmark scale, and success rates drop measurably on real code: AutoRocq, the closest recent system to our setting, proves 12 of 60 lemmas in a Linux kernel case study ( Tu et al., 2026 ) , and one cross-language vericoding benchmark reports success rates of 27% for Lean against 82% for Dafny ( Bursuc et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大多数演绎验证的自动化方法都将规格作为既定前提，并逐个处理证明义务，每次处理一个目标、引理或函数；标准基准正是以这种方式构建的。 在交互式证明器中，“锤子”工具会将已陈述的目标转换为外部自动化证明器（Böhme 和 Nipkow，2010；Czajka 和 Kaliszyk，2018），而基于学习或大语言模型的系统则会生成、修复或分解已陈述定理的证明（Jiang 等，2022；First 等，2023；Sanchez-Stern 等，2020；Kozyrev 等，2024；Lu 等，2024；Kasibatla 等，2026）。 像 Dafny、Frama-C/WP 和 Verus 这样的自动活跃验证器通过 SMT 求解器来验证验证条件（Leino，2010；Kirchner 等，2015；Lattuada 等，2024）；在此背景下，大语言模型的辅助功能可为验证失败提供辅助断言（Mugnier 等，2025）、证明提示（Loughridge 等，2025），或完成代码与其给定规格之间完整正确性证明的整个流程（Yang 等，2025）。 RefinedC 处于中间位置：一旦用户使用精化类型对 C 代码进行了标注，它就能自动完成基础证明的推导（Sammler 等，2021）。 这些方法中已报告的评估结果仍停留在基准规模，而在真实代码上的成功率则明显下降：AutoRocq 是近期最接近我们研究系统的工具，它在某项 Linux 内核案例研究中仅能证明 60 个引理中的 12 个（Tu 等，2026）；一项跨语言验证编码基准报告称，Lean 的成功率为 27%，而 Dafny 的成功率则为 82%（Bursuc 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: A second body of work generates the contracts or invariants themselves, or candidates for them. Classical techniques infer annotations within a fixed candidate space ( Flanagan and Leino, 2001 ) , detect likely invariants from execution traces ( Ernst et al., 2007 ) , or use bi-abduction to infer separation-logic footprints whose reference point is the absence of memory errors rather than functional design intent ( Calcagno et al., 2009 ) . LLM-based generators mostly target auto-active verifiers: goal-directed ACSL annotations validated by a weakest-precondition calculus ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , JML specifications ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Misu et al., 2026 ) , Verus specifications and proofs synthesized by self-evolution ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , LLM-drafted Dafny contracts frozen before proving ( Baksys et al., 2025 ) , and code–docstring–annotation triples checked for mutual consistency ( Sun et al., 2024 ) . Such validation remains empirical, though: over-constrained specifications that the sampled tests happen to satisfy escape detection. More fundamentally, none of these methods by itself connects a generated specification back to the intended design: the acceptance criterion is the code’s own behavior, the observed traces, or a stated target property, and verifier acceptance alone does not imply that a specification is correct or complete ( Misu et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: These generators also differ in direction. Most work locally or bottom-up: a function’s candidate contract is shaped by its own body, documentation, or tests, and where a call graph is used it schedules generation and validation rather than shaping content ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . The complementary, caller-driven direction derives a callee’s specification from its uses. Maximal specification synthesis infers the weakest callee assumptions that make a given client correct, recursively down the call graph ( Albarghouthi et al., 2016 ) ; angelic verification infers acceptable specifications of unknown environment functions from their usage context, in the service of bug finding ( Das et al., 2015 ) ; and two recent LLM-based systems scale the idea to whole codebases, deriving specifications from caller expectations through natural-language specifications and LLM-mediated Hoare-style reasoning ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , or through top-down inference in a restricted DSL discharged by bounded model checking ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . In these caller-driven lines the acceptance anchor is either mechanical or LLM-judged, and the evidence stops at bug findings or bounded verdicts. CCV’s analysis phase is inspired by the caller-expectation view of FM-Agent in particular ( Ding et al., 2026 ) ; it differs in that the propagated demands are recorded as natural-language contracts that a human gate reviews and freezes, and the resulting specifications are delivered as kernel-checked separation-logic proofs.
paragraphs.zh: 这些生成器在方向上也有所不同。 大多数方法采用局部或自底向上的方式：一个函数的候选合同由其自身主体、文档或测试塑造；若使用调用图，则它安排生成与验证，而非塑造内容（Wen et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2026b）。 与之互补的调用者驱动方向，则是从被调用者的使用场景中推导出其规范。 最大规范合成通过递归遍历调用图，推断出使给定客户端正确的最弱被调用者假设（Albarghouthi et al., 2016）；天使式验证则根据未知环境函数的使用上下文推断可接受的规范，以辅助发现错误（Das et al., 2015）；而近期两种基于大语言模型的系统则将这一思路扩展至整个代码库：一种通过自然语言规范和由大语言模型介导的霍耳风格推理，从调用者期望中推导出规范（Ding et al., 2026）；另一种则通过在受限领域特定语言中进行自上而下推断，并由有界模型检查验证，实现该目标（Sun et al., 2026）。 在这些调用者驱动的方法中，接受锚点要么是机械判定的，要么由大语言模型判断，而证据则止步于错误发现或有界判定结果。 CCV的分析阶段尤其受到FM-Agent中调用者期望观点的启发（Ding et al., 2026）；其不同之处在于，传播的需求被记录为自然语言合同，由人工审核员审查并锁定，最终生成的规范则以经过内核检查的分离逻辑证明形式交付。

paragraphs.en: What must ultimately be trusted also differs. Auto-active pipelines place the verifier and its toolchain in the trusted computing base, as they provide no independently checkable proofs ( Sammler et al., 2021 ) ; and for any deductive verifier the specification itself remains a trusted input, because an implementation proof “does not guarantee that the specification describes the behaviour the user expects” ( Klein et al., 2009 ) . Foundational multi-modal verifiers remove even the verifier from this base: in Velvet, the soundness of verification-condition generation is itself a machine-checked Lean theorem, and a property that survives randomized testing is admitted with sorry rather than entering the certificate ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . LLM-based generation changes who writes the artifacts, not who answers for them: in a recent large Rocq development the agent silently weakened a theorem statement during proof construction, and the authors conclude that statement review cannot be eliminated ( Paraskevopoulou, 2026 ) . CCV’s contribution is organizational rather than a new prover: an agent proposes contracts, lemmas, protocol definitions, and proofs; the Rocq kernel and mechanical gates re-check all formal evidence, so the agent stays outside the trusted computing base; and designated human gates review the conformance of the formal artifacts to the selected requirements, recorded as an explicit part of the machine-checked assurance case. Each of the lines above automates one stage of the path from code to reviewed evidence; CCV organizes these stages into a single codebase-level workflow.

paragraphs.en: We have presented CCV , an LLM-assisted framework for building auditable assurance cases that connect machine-checked program proofs to the intended requirements. Its two-phase method co-evolves function specifications and proofs, while an interface protocol models intended cross-interface use and guides the construction of composable contracts. Using VST in Rocq, CCV establishes memory safety and leak freedom under disclosed contracts and assumptions for all 299 function definitions across six C benchmarks, including industrial cryptographic components. Each benchmark requires less than one person-day of reported human effort. The resulting cases combine automated evidence construction with explicit human conformance review.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CCV，这是一个由大语言模型辅助的框架，用于构建可审计的保证案例，将机器验证的程序证明与预期要求连接起来。 其两阶段方法协同演化函数规格和证明，同时一个接口协议对跨接口的预期使用进行建模，并指导可组合合同的构建。 CCV 在 Rocq 中使用 VST，针对六个 C 基准测试中所有 299 个函数定义（包括工业级密码组件），在已公开的合同和假设下建立了内存安全性和无泄漏性。 每个基准测试报告所需的人工工作量均少于一个人日。 最终生成的案例结合了自动化的证据构建与明确的人工合规审查。

sents.en: Using VST in Rocq, CCV establishes memory safety and leak freedom under disclosed contracts and assumptions for all 299 function definitions across six C benchmarks, including industrial cryptographic components.
sents.zh: CCV 在 Rocq 中使用 VST，针对六个 C 基准测试中所有 299 个函数定义（包括工业级密码组件），在已公开的合同和假设下建立了内存安全性和无泄漏性。

sents.en: Each benchmark requires less than one person-day of reported human effort.
sents.zh: 每个基准测试报告所需的人工工作量均少于一个人日。

sents.en: The resulting cases combine automated evidence construction with explicit human conformance review.
sents.zh: 最终生成的案例结合了自动化的证据构建与明确的人工合规审查。
